prompt:
Create ONE standalone portrait MOBILE WEB screenshot of the supplied revised Vi2 account dashboard. Only the mobile interface, edge to edge, no desktop panel, browser chrome, device frame or comparison layout. This is the responsive companion to the desktop dashboard: preserve the same information architecture, brand and content. Retain Ink #11110f, Warm Paper #f5f2ed, Cream #eee6db, Stone #5e5a55; Bebas Neue for MY ACCOUNT, Inter for all body/controls. No new colors, green badges, gradients or display fonts in labels.

Use Vi2's compact mobile header with hamburger left, original logo centered, search and bag icons right. Comfortable normal 16px body, 14px labels, 44px targets, 24px outer gutters and generous section gaps. Let the screenshot be tall enough to show readable content, not a desktop compressed to fit.

MY ACCOUNT leads, then a modest identity row: neutral circle S, 'Welcome back, Seif', Edit account information as a clear link. Below with breathing room, a quiet single cream rewards-summary strip says Vi2 Points and 'Rewards are not available yet.' No invented points number, customer-since date, promo code or earning percentage.

Then three separate full-width task navigation rows with line icons, short descriptions and clear chevrons: My orders — View your recent and previous orders; Account information — Manage your name, email and password; Vi2 Points — View your rewards when available. These open focused pages. Use light horizontal separators rather than layered boxes, and do not place controls inside smaller nested cards. A discreet Sign out action sits below after a divider. There are NO editing input fields, password form, receipts, long order list, recommended products or marketing/trust sections on this dashboard.

Finish with a compact familiar black Vi2 footer separated from main tasks. Preserve the spacious hierarchy of the desktop reference. This phone layout is an original responsive proposal based on the provided desktop structure, not a claim about iHerb's actual mobile layout.
sampleContent: No real customer contact, reward code, balance or dates reproduced
reference: User-supplied iHerb desktop screenshots for structure; existing Vi2 artwork/tokens for identity
approval: Seif explicitly approved revision 3 and requested frontend implementation on 2026-10-20
